假定n个Buff，m个目标，支持如下模式：
0：（量大管饱）总共施加k*m个Buff：对m个对象中的每1个对象，从n个Buff中随机选k个不同的Buff添加，k取MaxCount参数，k不填or填0代表k=n，即给m个对象都挂全部Buff；
1：（按序发放，最多1个）总共施加min(n,m)个Buff：n个Buff里按顺序分给m个对象，直至Buff拿空，或者对象耗尽；
2：（随机发放，最多1个）总共施加min(n,m)个Buff：n个Buff挨个随机分给m个对象中的某一个，对象不可重复被选中（无放回的随机），直到Buff耗尽，或者对象耗尽；
3：（按序发放，发完为止）总共施加n个Buff：n个Buff按顺序分给m个对象，轮完一圈的话从头继续，直至Buff耗尽；
4：（随机发放，发完为止）总共施加n个Buff：n个Buff挨个随机分给m个对象中的某一个，对象可重复被选中（有放回的随机），直到Buff耗尽；
5：（按序发放，1人1个）总共施加m个Buff：n个Buff按顺序分给m个对象，如果n个发完还不够，则从头继续发Buff，直到m个对象都加上了Buff；
6：（随机发放无放回，1人1个）总共施加m个Buff：n个Buff无放回的随机分给m个对象，如果n个发完还不够，则从头继续随机发一轮Buff，直到m个对象都加上了Buff；
7：（随机发放有放回，1人1个）总共施加m个Buff：n个Buff有放回的随机分给m个对象；

<Assistant_Title2>介绍：</>廷根的街头，偶尔能遇到一只充满趣味的“鲁恩式幽默”对话的灵猫。
<Assistant_Title2>玩法指引：</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. 寻找灵猫</>
可通过以下任一方式前往玩法：
<Assistant_Property2>跑团入口：</>打开菜单进入【跑团】，加入任意教团后，在【秩序世界】中选择【寻猫奇遇记】，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Property1>地图入口：</>打开地图，切换至【探秘】页签，在【世界详情】中查看【寻猫奇遇记】玩法图标，并根据图标指引，在地图中找到对应标识，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Title3>2. 发现灵猫</>
到达目标区域后，旁听附近NPC的对话，获得灵猫的线索，并根据镜头指引找到灵猫。
<Assistant_Title3>3. 完成互动</>
与灵猫对话并完成骰子检定。
<Assistant_Red>检定成功：</>可直接获得宝箱奖励。
<Assistant_Red>检定失败：</>跟随灵猫继续完成对话，仍可获得对应奖励。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Cat-Seeking Adventure】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction: </>On the streets of Tingen, you can occasionally encounter a spirit cat that engages in amusing "Loen-style humor" dialogue.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide: </>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Finding the Spirit Cat</>
You can navigate to this activity using either of the following methods:
<Assistant_Property2>TTRPG Entry:</>Open the Menu, enter [TTRPG], join any organization, select [Cat-Seeking Adventure] in the [Orderly World], and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entry:</>Open the map, switch to the [Exploration] tab, view the [Cat-Seeking Adventure] icon in [World Details], find the corresponding marker on the map based on the icon's guidance, and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Discovering the Spirit Cat</>
After arriving at the target area, eavesdrop on the nearby NPC's dialogue to obtain clues about the spirit cat, and follow the camera guidance to find it.
<Assistant_Title3>3. Completing the Interaction</>
Speak with the spirit cat and complete the dice check.
<Assistant_Red>Check Success:</>You can obtain the treasure chest reward directly.
<Assistant_Red>Check Failure:</>Follow the spirit cat to finish the conversation, and you can still obtain the corresponding reward.

ref_en: A mysterious drink called 'Caramel Bomb' leads you to the most urgent intestinal crisis of your life. You rush into the restroom, only to find two devout students chanting a holy name toward the toilet. It turns out you are not the only victim of this 'sacred poison'. You and the drink's inventor, Shermin, try to optimize this sinful sweet water. After several attempts, the formula becomes increasingly mysterious, and a desperate Shermin pours the residue into the toilet—the toilet becomes as clean as new! A week later, every Tingen citizen has a bottle of lemon-scented cleaning agent, while the students who light candles and pray in the restroom are still hoping for the return of the 'Caramel Bomb'.

source_cn:
身为军人和虔诚的信徒，赛瑞斯在火与血，疯狂与未知中积累功勋。从普通步兵到非凡者，他获得的一切都来自军队。
他不怀疑杀戮的意义，既然要为国家争夺利益，要为自己争夺荣誉，就不应该再感到怯懦与不忍——那将让他更容易死去。
“再把枪擦亮，士兵。”1350年的一个深夜，赛瑞斯在战壕里低语：“既然休战的命令没有发布，我们仍要奋战到最后一刻，你和我的身后是祖国的期待，我们要拿下胜利，才有活着的可能。”
“不要怕，神会注视着你。”
“赞美太阳！”
ref_en:
As a soldier and a devout believer, Cyrus accumulated merit amidst fire, blood, madness, and the unknown. From an ordinary infantryman to a Beyonder, everything he gained came from the army. 
 He does not doubt the meaning of killing. Since he must fight for the country's interests and for his own honor, he should no longer feel cowardly or hesitant—that would only make him die more easily. 
 "Polish your rifle again, soldier." Late one night in 1350, Cyrus whispered in the trenches: "Since the order to cease fire has not been issued, we must fight to the last moment. Behind you and me lies the expectation of our motherland; only by securing victory do we have a chance to live." 
 "Do not be afraid, God will watch over you." 
 "Praise the Sun!"

...

source_cn:
知识是被扛在肩上的，它有重量，会消耗体力，背负者必须为它付出代价。
　　这个古老民族或许比后世许多哲学体系更早地触及了一个真相——知道得越多，承受得越重。
　　遗憾的是，现存文献大多残损。本书所能依赖的，仅有零星出土的陶片刻铭、后世抄本中的引述，以及邻近语族中若干可疑的同源词。这些材料足以暗示方向，却不足以支撑定论。
　　笔者如实呈现证据的匮乏，而非用推测填补空白——在语源学这门学科里，承认无知本身就是一种诚实。
ref_en:
Knowledge is carried on the shoulders; it has weight and consumes physical strength, and the bearer must pay a price for it. 
 This ancient nation perhaps touched a truth earlier than many later philosophical systems—the more you know, the heavier you bear. 
 Regrettably, most existing documents are damaged. What this book can rely on are only sporadic inscriptions on unearthed pottery shards, citations in later manuscripts, and several suspicious cognate words in neighboring language families. These materials are enough to suggest a direction, but not enough to support a conclusion. 
 The author presents the lack of evidence truthfully, rather than filling the gaps with speculation—in the discipline of etymology, admitting ignorance itself is a kind of honesty.

近期某些爱情小说，引发了对吸血鬼不必要的狂热。
现做以下概念澄清，帮助大家进行严谨的小说创作：
吸血鬼多指因为黑暗力量而产生吸血冲动的堕落个体，在小说中应充当反派角色。
若有必要创作相关小说，应采用“血族”一词。血族指古老智慧的血液贵族，他们恪守传统，注重礼仪，更应被当做主角书写。
笔者倡议多创作以血族为主角的荣耀小说，避免过分沉溺虚幻的恋爱情节。
ref_en:
Recent romance novels have sparked unnecessary fanaticism about vampires.
I am making the following conceptual clarifications to help everyone with rigorous novel writing:
"Vampire" mostly refers to fallen individuals who have developed an urge to suck blood due to dark powers, and should act as villains in novels.
If it is necessary to write related novels, the term "Blood Clan" should be used. Blood Clan refers to ancient and wise blood aristocrats who adhere to traditions, pay attention to etiquette, and should be written as protagonists.
I advocate writing more glorious novels with Blood Clan as protagonists, avoiding excessive indulgence in illusory romantic plots.
The response application for Family %s has been approved.

source_cn:
木偶生来就是没有灵魂的，它被切割，被打磨，被拼凑。
细长而锋利的鱼线穿过木偶的胸腔和四肢，它感受不到疼痛。
破旧的棕色油渍布条裹住木偶的身体，它没有选择美或丑的权利。
工匠用鲜艳的红黄色油彩涂在木偶脸上，它像马戏团的小丑，悲和喜都只能张开嘴大笑。
木偶曾被许多手掌提着线，灵活地摆出动作，保持微笑，得到许多人的掌声和赞叹。
一只木偶的生命有多长？几个月后鱼线断裂，布条腐烂，油彩褪色，它被新的木偶取代，被遗忘在无人的角落。
在潮湿幽暗的地方，木偶缓缓咧开僵硬的嘴角，露出小丑般滑稽的笑容，于是谁的灵魂也成为提线木偶，被凿出许多孔洞，穿上无形的细线，关节开始滞涩……
“来变成我的同类吧。”木偶一字一顿，声音如同腐烂的木头，“这样我就永远不会被丢下了……”
ref_en:
A puppet is born without a soul; it is cut, polished, and assembled. 
 Thin, sharp fishing lines pass through the puppet's chest and limbs; it cannot feel pain. 
 Worn-out brown oily cloth wraps the puppet's body; it has no right to choose beauty or ugliness. 
 The craftsman paints the puppet's face with bright red and yellow oil paint; like a circus clown, it can only open its mouth to laugh, whether in sorrow or joy. 
 The puppet has been held by many palms, nimbly posing, keeping a smile, and receiving applause and admiration from many. 
 How long is the life of a puppet? A few months later, the fishing line breaks, the cloth rots, the paint fades, and it is replaced by a new puppet, forgotten in a deserted corner. 
 In a damp and gloomy place, the puppet slowly grins its stiff mouth, revealing a clown-like, comical smile. Thus, someone's soul also becomes a marionette, chiseled with many holes, threaded with invisible lines, and the joints begin to show stagnation... 
 "Come and become my kind." The puppet spoke word by word, its voice like rotting wood, "That way, I will never be left behind again..."

source_cn: 玩法介绍</> 神座之争为组队竞技玩法，最多可组成6人队伍参与匹配。神座之争玩法内，所有玩家采用与玩法外相同的<Highlight>真实</>属性进行战斗。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>获胜条件</> 限时时间内击败敌方队伍内所有玩家获胜，若对局时间结束时双方队伍均有成员存活，则顺次按照击败人数、存活人数、伤害总量、存活血量判定较高的一方获胜。在神座之争玩法里，每个队伍拥有<Highlight>2次复活</>死亡队友的机会。
ref_en: Gameplay Introduction</> Battle for the Throne of God is a team competition mode, where up to 6 players can form a team to participate in matchmaking. In the Battle for the Throne of God mode, all players use the same <Highlight>Real</> attributes as outside the mode for combat. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Winning Conditions</> Defeat all players in the enemy team within the time limit to win. If both teams have members alive when the match time ends, the side with more kills, more survivors, higher total damage, and higher remaining health will be judged the winner in order. In the Battle for the Throne of God mode, each team has <Highlight>2 opportunities to resurrect</> dead teammates.

<Assistant_Title2>Description: </>Attack-type Sealed Artifact
<Assistant_Title2>Details: </>A dungeon-oriented Sealed Artifact. Notarization occurs when casting basic and ultimate skills. source_cn:
<M_Default>亲爱的非凡者：</>
<M_Default>《诡秘之主》公测已至，非凡世界的大门已向您敞开，欢迎踏上这片真实与隐秘交织的大地。</>

<M_Default>为感谢您在【灰雾测试】期间的陪伴与信任，您曾留下的那一笔笔“投资”，如今穿梭灵界而来，化作更加丰富的返还奖励。</>请前往<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=2000067">廷根·吉福特</>处领取您的充值返还奖励。

ref_en:
<M_Default>Dear Beyonder: </>
<M_Default>The public beta of "Lord of Mysteries" has arrived, and the door to the Extraordinary World has opened to you. Welcome to this land intertwined with reality and mystery. </>

<M_Default>To thank you for your companionship and trust during the [Gray Fog Test], the "investments" you left behind have now traveled through the Spirit World and transformed into even richer return rewards. </>Please go to <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=2000067">Tingen Gifford</> to claim your recharge return rewards. 

May these returns make your journey in the new world even more enjoyable.
<P_Heart> (Whispering) </> Need to be careful with my words next time...

source_cn: 猎杀时刻活动时间</> <Highlight>每日19:00—20:00</>开放；每周六、周日额外开放<Highlight>14:00—15:00</>。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>王城区域限时事件</> 猎杀时刻期间，可在王城中心【异变营地】限时召唤<Highlight>命运人偶</>，击败后可获得猩红遗物材料。 每周五、周日晚的猎杀时刻开启<Highlight>10分钟后</>，即<Highlight>19:10</>，王城中心将刷新<Highlight>巨龙·投影</>。击退巨龙时，当前有效归属伤害最高的团队获得拍卖奖励。每次猎杀时刻活动中，每名玩家至多获得<Highlight>1次</>巨龙·投影的终末猎杀拍卖资格；已取得资格的玩家，本次活动内无法再次取得。 除周五、周日晚场外，其他猎杀时刻开始<Highlight>10分钟后</>，王城中心将刷新<Highlight>王城守卫者</>。击败王城守卫者后，完成最后一击的团队成员共享对应奖励。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>段位胜点双倍收益</> 猎杀时刻期间，击杀敌对玩家可掠夺<Highlight>双倍段位胜点</>；被击杀时，损失的段位胜点同样翻倍。
ref_en: Hunting Time Event Hours </> <Highlight> Open daily from 19:00—20:00 </>; additional hours on Saturdays and Sundays from <Highlight> 14:00—15:00 </>. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Royal City Area Limited-Time Event </> During Hunting Time, you can summon a <Highlight> Fate Marionette </> for a limited time at the [Mutated Camp] in the center of the Royal City; defeating it yields Scarlet Relic materials. 10 minutes after <Highlight> the start of Hunting Time on Friday and Sunday nights </>, i.e., <Highlight> 19:10 </>, a <Highlight> Dragon - Projection </> will spawn in the center of the Royal City. When the dragon is repelled, the team with the highest effective attributed damage receives the auction rewards. In each Hunting Time event, each player can obtain at most <Highlight> 1 </> qualification for the Dragon - Projection Final Hunt auction; players who have already obtained the qualification cannot obtain it again during this event. Except for the Friday and Sunday night sessions, 10 minutes after <Highlight> other Hunting Time sessions begin </>, the <Highlight> Royal City Guardian </> will spawn in the center of the Royal City. After defeating the Royal City Guardian, team members who land the final blow share the corresponding rewards. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Double Rank Point Gains </> During Hunting Time, killing hostile players allows you to plunder <Highlight> double rank points </>; when killed, the rank points lost are also doubled.

与誓约组队完成各类日常玩法即可获得誓约值与同行纹章，誓约值可用于自动提升誓约等级。
誓约等级共设多级，达到指定等级可领取等级奖励。
非凡者每日与单个誓约最多可获取600誓约值，每周最多可获取2000誓约值。与誓约对象组队参与指定活动，还可额外获得同行纹章。
与誓约对象组队参与乌托邦剧院双人模式，会获得更多誓约值与同行纹章，玩法中还会有额外能力加成。
同行纹章可用于在同行商店购买物品（誓约相关的奖励需要与誓约的等级达到指定要求）。
非凡者可点击更换展台，进入与对应誓约对象的主页编辑功能，非凡者可更换自己角色的动作（不可编辑对方的），更换双人主页的展台，摆放摆件。
非凡者可以在萨默尔太太处申请单人解契，申请后会开始为期24小时的冷静期，冷静期结束后可以正式在萨默尔太太处缴纳苏勒解除誓约，冷静期间发起申请的非凡者可以取消解契。
非凡者也可组队前往萨默尔太太处申请双人解除解约，申请后会开始为期24小时的冷静期，冷静期结束后可以正式在萨默尔太太处缴纳少量苏勒解除誓约，冷静期间双方可以取消解契。
ref_en:
Form a team with your Oath partner to complete various daily activities to earn Oath Points and Companion Emblems. Oath Points can be used to automatically increase your Oath Level. 
 There are multiple Oath Levels, and you can claim level rewards upon reaching specified levels. 
 A Beyonder can earn a maximum of 600 Oath Points per day with a single Oath partner, and a maximum of 2000 per week. Participate in designated activities while teamed up with your Oath partner to earn additional Companion Emblems. 
 Teaming up with your Oath partner for the Utopia Theater Duo Mode will grant more Oath Points and Companion Emblems, along with additional ability bonuses during the activity. 
 Companion Emblems can be used to purchase items in the Companion Shop (Oath-related rewards require your Oath Level to meet specific requirements). 
 Beyonders can click to change the display stand to enter the homepage editing function for the corresponding Oath partner. Beyonders can change their own character's actions (you cannot edit the other person's), change the display stand on the duo homepage, and place ornaments. 
 Beyonders can apply for a solo Oath dissolution at Mrs. Sammer's. After applying, a 24-hour cooling-off period will begin. Once the cooling-off period ends, you can officially pay the Soules at Mrs. Sammer's to dissolve the Oath. During the cooling-off period, the Beyonder who initiated the application can Cancel the dissolution. 
 Beyonders can also team up to go to Mrs. Sammer's to apply for a duo Oath dissolution. After applying, a 24-hour cooling-off period will begin. Once the cooling-off period ends, both parties can officially pay a small amount of Soules at Mrs. Sammer's to dissolve the Oath. During the cooling-off period, both parties can Cancel the dissolution.

source_cn: 积分说明</> 在<Highlight>战略服筛选阶段</>的联赛前两轮，将启用战略服筛选积分规则。战略服筛选积分与用于判定当前比赛胜负的<Highlight>局内积分相互独立</>。局内积分用于决定当前比赛的胜负与名次；战略服筛选积分根据每场比赛名次及每轮最终排名累计，用于决定俱乐部的战略服筛选排名与晋级资格。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>单场名次积分</> 每场比赛结束后，根据俱乐部在该场比赛中的最终名次获得战略服筛选积分： <Highlight>第1名：30分</> <Highlight>第2名：15分</> <Highlight>第3名：10分</> <Highlight>第4名：5分</> <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>第一轮最终排名积分</> 第一轮全部比赛结束后，根据俱乐部最终排名额外获得战略服筛选积分： <Highlight>第1名：60分</> <Highlight>第2名：50分</> <Highlight>第3名：45分</> <Highlight>第4名：40分</> <Highlight>第5至第8名：10分</> <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>第二轮最终排名积分</> 第二轮全部比赛结束后，根据俱乐部最终排名额外获得战略服筛选积分： <Highlight>第1名：200分</> <Highlight>第2名：100分</> <Highlight>第3名：70分</> <Highlight>第4名：50分</> <Highlight>第5至第8名：15分</> 战略服筛选阶段的联赛前两轮结束后，将根据各俱乐部累计获得的<Highlight>战略服筛选总积分</>进行排名。本赛区战略服筛选总积分<Highlight>前4名</>的俱乐部将晋级<Highlight>四方联赛天启组</>，并获得<Highlight>参与战略服</>的资格。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>同分排序规则</> 战略服筛选排名优先按照<Highlight>战略服筛选总积分</>由高到低排列。总积分相同时：第一轮或第二轮联赛结束后，按照俱乐部在本轮的<Highlight>最终排名</>排序，排名靠前者优先；四方联赛每轮第一场比赛结束后，本轮尚未产生最终排名，同分俱乐部暂不区分排名先后，当前展示顺序不代表本轮最终排名。
ref_en: Points Explanation</> During the first two rounds of the league in the <Highlight>Strategic Server Screening Phase</>, the Strategic Server Screening points rules will be enabled. Strategic Server Screening points are independent of the <Highlight>In-match Points</> used to determine the outcome of the current match. In-match Points are used to determine the victory and ranking of the current match; Strategic Server Screening points are accumulated based on the ranking of each match and the final ranking of each round, and are used to determine the club's Strategic Server Screening ranking and qualification for advancement. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Single Match Ranking Points</> After each match, Strategic Server Screening points are awarded based on the club's final ranking in that match: <Highlight>1st Place: 30 points</> <Highlight>2nd Place: 15 points</> <Highlight>3rd Place: 10 points</> <Highlight>4th Place: 5 points</> <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>First Round Final Ranking Points</> After all matches in the first round are completed, additional Strategic Server Screening points are awarded based on the club's final ranking: <Highlight>1st Place: 60 points</> <Highlight>2nd Place: 50 points</> <Highlight>3rd Place: 45 points</> <Highlight>4th Place: 40 points</> <Highlight>5th to 8th Place: 10 points</> <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Second Round Final Ranking Points</> After all matches in the second round are completed, additional Strategic Server Screening points are awarded based on the club's final ranking: <Highlight>1st Place: 200 points</> <Highlight>2nd Place: 100 points</> <Highlight>3rd Place: 70 points</> <Highlight>4th Place: 50 points</> <Highlight>5th to 8th Place: 15 points</> After the first two rounds of the league in the Strategic Server Screening phase are completed, rankings will be based on the <Highlight>Total Strategic Server Screening Points</> accumulated by each club. The top <Highlight>4 clubs</> in total Strategic Server Screening points for this division will advance to the <Highlight>Four-Way League Apocalypse Group</> and gain the qualification to <Highlight>participate in the Strategic Server</>. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Tie-breaking Rules</> The Strategic Server Screening ranking is primarily ordered from high to low based on <Highlight>Total Strategic Server Screening Points</>. When total points are tied: After the first or second round of the league, clubs are ranked according to their <Highlight>Final Ranking</> in that round, with higher rankings taking precedence; after the first match of each round of the Four-Way League, if a final ranking for the round has not yet been determined, tied clubs will not be distinguished by rank, and the current display order does not represent the final ranking for the round.

<Assistant_Title1>【教团/跑团】</>
<Assistant_System>教团</>是跑团体系中的核心成长与阵营系统。加入教团后，你可以获得独立的<Assistant_Property1>教团等级</>、<Assistant_Property1>教团属性</>和对应教团的专属玩法。

<Assistant_Title2>主要内容：</>
1. 选择教团并完成属性配置。
2. 通过教团玩法获得教团行动值以及各类奖励。

<Assistant_Title1>【Coven/TRPG】</>
<Assistant_System>Coven </> is the core growth and faction system in the TRPG system. After joining a Coven, you can obtain an independent <Assistant_Property1>Coven Level</>, <Assistant_Property1>Coven Attributes</>, and exclusive gameplay for that Coven. 

<Assistant_Title2>Main Content: </>
1. Choose a Coven and complete attribute configuration. 
2. Obtain Coven Action Points and various rewards through Coven gameplay. 
3. Increase Coven Level to unlock rewards like actions, appearances, and titles. 
4. Use attributes like Charisma, Intuition, Knowledge, and Might for checks during exploration and Coven gameplay. 

<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Searches: </>{SendAnswer:[How to Join a Coven]|1273}, {SendAnswer:[Coven Attribute Explanation]|1275}, {SendAnswer:[Coven Action Points and Weekly Cap]|1276}

Name: See Me

To make myself strong and rely on my own power to return to my hometown, rather than pinning my hopes on dangerous external forces. But my choice back then was still too rash. source_cn:
从前有一个小女孩，只有一只眼睛，没有妈妈。

有一天，月亮送给她一只兔子。 兔子说：我帮你找妈妈。 小女孩说：好呀好呀。

兔子找来了第一个妈妈， 把她变成了一只蝴蝶。 小女孩说：太好啦，蝴蝶妈妈不会跑走了。

兔子又找来第二个，第三个，第四个…… 蝴蝶越来越多， 小女孩的口袋里装满了翅膀的声音。

有人问她：你不难过吗？ 小女孩想了想，说： 难过的时候，我就数一数蝴蝶， 一只，两只，三只…… 数着数着就好了。

【全文完】
ref_en:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl who had only one eye and no mother. 

 One day, the moon gave her a rabbit. The rabbit said: I will help you find your mother. The little girl said: Yay, yay. 

 The rabbit brought the first mother, and turned her into a butterfly. The little girl said: That's great, Butterfly Mother won't run away anymore. 

 The rabbit brought a second, a third, a fourth... There were more and more butterflies, and the little girl's pockets were filled with the sound of wings. 

 Someone asked her: Aren't you sad? The little girl thought for a moment and said: When I'm sad, I count the butterflies, one, two, three... and after counting, I feel better. 

 【End of Story】

%s:
      我听闻你与星象仪者遭遇了一场苦战。不必过分担忧。在过去的岁月循环中，我已经明白失败与胜利——乃至生存与死亡——都不过是一时的、相对的：它只是你旅途中的一个普通坐标，用来验证你的成长。谨记面对星象仪者的诀窍：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302117">星象仪者</>
      对于一位总在路上的旅人来说，我知道让人停下脚步的常常并非挫折本身，而是失去了再次上路的勇气。所幸你并不胆怯于面对更多新冒险，我想下次，我听到的就会是更好的消息。对你这样年轻的非凡者而言，你已经做得很好。
      如果你需要的话，漫长的时光为我积淀下一些经验，也许对你有用。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查看</>
ref_en:
%s:
      I heard you had a bitter struggle with the Astrolabe User. Do not worry too much. In the cycles of the past, I have come to understand that failure and victory—and even life and death—are merely temporary and relative: they are just ordinary coordinates on your journey, used to verify your growth. Keep in mind the trick to facing the Astrolabe User: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302117">Astrolabe User</>
      For a traveler who is always on the road, I know that what often makes people stop is not the setback itself, but the loss of courage to set off again. Fortunately, you are not timid about facing more new adventures. I think next time, what I hear will be better news. For a young Beyonder like you, you have already done very well. 
      If you need it, the long passage of time has accumulated some experience for me, which might be useful to you. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to view</>

1.榜单数据将每分钟自动更新一次，确保信息及时。

1. Leaderboard data will automatically update every minute to ensure information is timely. 
2. Some leaderboards support filtering by pathway; you can click the "All Pathways" button at the top to switch. 
3. Some leaderboards support viewing regional rankings; click the corresponding regional tab above to switch. 
4. Click your own information row at the bottom of the leaderboard to quickly locate and jump to your current ranking position. 
5. Click other Beyonders' information rows to view their appearance; click their avatar to further view their personal profile. 
6. Once you reach King of Angels in any rank and are in the top 30 of the overall leaderboard or top 5 of a pathway, you will obtain the Lord of Stars rank for 14 days. If you still meet the conditions after the rank points change, the duration will refresh to 14 days.

source_cn:
几年过去了，我从序列9一步步爬到序列5，成了“天文学家”。每天晚上观测星象，计算仪式节点，离“炼金术士”只剩一步之遥。
　　但这一步需要的东西太多，钱，资源，还有……人。
　　子弹的事是我经手的，三百发特种弹药，我叫它们“金弹”，能让人短暂获得强大的力量。
　　我亲手改档案，报消耗，分批次运出去。“审判官”现在已经是我忠诚的仆人，他会用这些金弹来吸引足够多的人——小偷、流氓、杀手……管他是谁，让那些对现状不满的底层们有个投奔的地方。等他们聚集起来，仪式就能启动。
　　他们会成为祭品。没关系，反正都是些渣滓，腐肉，清理掉也对廷根有好处。
ref_en:
Years have passed, and I have climbed step by step from Sequence 9 to Sequence 5, becoming an "Astronomer." Every night I observe the stars and calculate the ritual nodes, and I am only one step away from becoming an "Alchemist." 
 But this step requires too many things: money, resources, and... people. 
 The matter of the bullets was handled by me; three hundred special ammunition, I call them "Gold Bullets," which can allow people to briefly gain powerful strength. 
 I personally altered the files, reported the consumption, and shipped them out in batches. The "Inquisitor" is now my loyal servant; he will use these Gold Bullets to attract enough people—thieves, hooligans, killers... whoever they are, let those at the bottom who are dissatisfied with the status quo have a place to go. Once they gather, the ritual can be started. 
 They will become sacrifices. It doesn't matter; they are all scum and rot anyway, and cleaning them up is good for Tingen.

作者：匿名流浪骑士 


　　这是一本记载于羊皮卷上的荒诞冒险手记，全书以癫狂的笔触描述了一位第四纪自称“被诅咒的勇者”的离奇经历——他走遍大陆收集了117枚古代邪神硬币，解开了83处遗迹谜题，甚至帮某位商人送了200次快递，却始终拒绝营救被封印在宫殿的莱拉公主。
　　本书列举了此勇者不救公主的一百种理由。
ref_en:
Author: Anonymous Wandering Knight 
 
 
 This is an absurd adventure journal recorded on parchment. The whole book describes with a frantic touch the bizarre experiences of a person in the Fourth Epoch who called himself the "Cursed Hero"—he traveled across the continent collecting 117 ancient evil god coins, solved 83 ruin puzzles, and even helped a certain merchant deliver 200 packages, yet he always refused to rescue Princess Laila who was sealed in the palace. 
 This book lists one hundred reasons why this hero did not save the princess.

我要输了。但我仍然认为数字远比文字更为深奥、迷人。

蒙特不认同。所以我们各自打开一本隐秘的书，冒着死去或变成木偶的风险，从这两件封印物中寻找证明。

不幸读到这里的人——你可能和我有着相同的命运。这本书吞噬了数字和信息。而<InvHighlight>三个水晶球是再次封印它的唯一方式 </>。三，几何学里最小的封闭结构。在数字本身被隐去后，你所能依靠的只有数字之间的关系，这是你唯一的希望。

请记住：<InvHighlight>α等于“失序之书”书名的字数 </>，是第一个内藏关系的数字，在它之前的数字都是不可被分割的整体。

<InvHighlight> α</>等于<InvHighlight>4</> 
<InvHighlight> β</>等于<InvHighlight>3</> 
<InvHighlight> ω</>等于<InvHighlight>2</>
ref_en:
I am going to lose. But I still believe that numbers are far more profound and fascinating than words. 

Monte disagrees. So we each opened a secret book, risking death or becoming a puppet, to find proof from these two Sealed Artifacts. 

Whoever reads this by misfortune—you might share the same fate as me. This book devours numbers and information. And <InvHighlight>the three crystal balls are the only way to seal it again </>. Three, the smallest closed structure in geometry. After the numbers themselves are hidden, all you can rely on is the relationship between the numbers; this is your only hope. 

Please remember: <InvHighlight>α equals the number of characters in the title of the "Book of Disorder" </>, it is the first number that contains a relationship, and all numbers before it are indivisible wholes. 

<InvHighlight> α</> equals <InvHighlight>4</> 
<InvHighlight> β</> equals <InvHighlight>3</> 
<InvHighlight> ω</> equals <InvHighlight>2</>
